# `docid`

[Feature reference](0_home.md)

**Module:** core

**Kind:** node feature

## Description

document identifier, from <docID>, whitespace-stripped. NOT unique: 141 values are shared by more than one document node, so a (docid, ...) section address can be ambiguous. `docgroup` nodes group the records that share one, but section addressing itself is still ambiguous.
